-
February 2026

-
               [DISA’s acquisition reforms answer Secretary Hegseth's call for speed and agility](/NewsandEvents/2026/0225-DISA-acquisition-reforms)

-
02/25/2026

-
               In response to the Department of War's mandate for sweeping acquisition reform, DISA is adopting a new model that has already been slashing delivery times and rapidly fielding integrated capabilities for warfighters.

-

-
December 2025

-
               [DISA director calls for strengthened industry partnerships to deliver integrated capabilities to warfighters](/NewsandEvents/2025/1208-Forecast-to-Industry-Post-story)

-
12/08/2025

-
               Speaking to a hybrid audience of several thousand in-person and virtual attendees at DISA’s Forecast to Industry 2025 event, Army Lt. Gen. Stanton outlined the agency’s strategic direction and underscored the critical role industry plays in achieving its mission.

-

-
November 2025

-
               [DISA awards $931 million other transaction agreement for data center modernization and cloud instance initiative](/NewsandEvents/2025/1120-data-center-modernization-and-cloud-instance-initiative)

-
11/20/2025

-
               The Defense Information Systems Agency awarded a $931 million other transaction agreement to Hewlett Packard Enterprise to modernize its data centers as part of the DISA Cloud Instance initiative. This effort is a critical component of the DISA Cloud Environment, which encompasses the entire DISA Cloud portfolio aimed at enhancing the agency's capabilities to support mission-critical operations for the Department of War and its partners.

-

-
August 2025

-
               [Disciplined analysis drives comprehensive cyber defense](/NewsandEvents/2025/0820-Disciplined-analysis-CSSP)

-
08/20/2025

-
               DISA's Cybersecurity Service Provider utilizes disciplined analysis and tailored analytics to proactively defend the Defense Information Systems Network against advanced cyber threats.

-

-
               [DISA leverages Johns Hopkins University innovation to enhance military capabilities ](/NewsandEvents/2025/0818-DISA-Leverages-Johns-Hopkins)

-
08/18/2025

-
               DISA's contract with Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) provides the Department of Defense with critical, rapid, and cost-effective technology solutions to enhance battlefield readiness.

-

-
               [DISA Pacific welcomes new commander in USS Missouri ceremony](/NewsandEvents/2025/0805-DISA-PAC-CoC)

-
08/05/2025

-
               Marine Corps Col. Michael T. Hlad assumes command of DISA Pacific in a ceremony aboard the USS Missouri, succeeding Col. Jared C. Voneida.

-

-
               [DISA JELAs prioritize user experience and warfighter readiness](/NewsandEvents/2025/0804-DISA-JELA)

-
08/04/2025

-
               This strategic focus involves streamlining procurement, providing robust vendor support, and fostering strong industry partnerships to deliver IT solutions that meet both technical requirements and user needs.

-

-
July 2025

-
               [DISA Global Field Command welcomes new leader](/NewsandEvents/2025/0729-DISA-Global-CoC)

-
07/29/2025

-
               Air Force Col. Michael T. McDaniel passed command of DISA Global Field Command to Army Col. Duane M. Williams during a change of command ceremony July 21 on Scott Air Force Base, Illinois.

-

-
               [DISA Central change of command marks new chapter in leadership amid global challenges](/NewsandEvents/2025/0714-DISA-Central-CoC)

-
07/14/2025

-
               The Defense Information Systems Agency’s Central Field Command marked a leadership transition July 2, ensuring continuity within the complex and contested cyber domain of U.S. Central Command’s area of responsibility.

-

-
               [DISA director urges cyber professionals to embrace warfighting mindset at HammerCon 2025](/NewsandEvents/2025/0701-DISA-director-at-HammerCon)

-
07/01/2025

-
               During a fireside chat, Stanton shared his insights on the evolution of cyber operations and insisted on a coordinated, proactive approach to defending the Department of Defense Information Network.

-

-
June 2025

-
               [DISA Citadel receives cross-domain solution authorization, extends software transfer capability to customers](/NewsandEvents/2025/0624-DISA-Citadel-cross-domain-solution-authorization)

-
06/24/2025

-
               The approval of a cross-domain solution now allows for faster, secure data transfers between unclassified and classified systems, resolving a long-standing challenge.

-

-
               [DISA's Cloud Infrastructure as Code accelerates DOD cloud adoption, saving time and money ](/NewsandEvents/2025/0611-Cloud-Infrastructure-as-Code-accelerates-DOD-cloud-adoption)

-

-
06/11/2025     Customers are using DISA's DOD Cloud Infrastructure as code to deploy secure cloud environments in weeks, significantly faster than previous timelines. DISA's J-9 Hosting and Compute team is leading this effort to accelerate cloud adoption within the department.

-

-

-
               [DISA transforms DODNet operations to drive efficiency ](/NewsandEvents/2025/0610-DISA-transforms-DODNet)

-

-
06/11/2025     Defense Information Systems Agency is modernizing and streamlining DODNet operations through advanced technology. These improvements are preparing the network for large-scale migrations of Defense Agencies and Field Activities, while delivering data-driven, cloud-based management services, automation tools, Zero Trust cyber compliance and a better user experience.

-

-

-
May 2025

-
               [DISA awards OTA for Fangorn mainframe prototype](/NewsandEvents/2025/0528-DISA-awards-OTA-for-Fangorn-mainframe-prototype)

-

-
05/28/2025     DISA awarded World Wide Technology an Other Transaction Agreement for the Fangorn prototype, a first-of-its-kind cloud platform engineered to modernize legacy mainframe systems for U.S. Warfighters.

-

-

-
               [65 years of innovation: How DISA has transformed military communications](/NewsandEvents/2025/0512-DISA-65th-Birthday)

-
05/12/2025

-
               For 65 years, the Defense Information Systems Agency has been the backbone of military communications, ensuring that the U.S. armed forces stay connected, secure and mission ready.

-

-
               [Partnerships power progress: DISA deputy director emphasizes industry collaboration at TechNet Cyber 2025 ](/NewsandEvents/2025/0509-Partnerships-power-progress)

-
05/09/2025

-
               Defense Information Systems Agency Deputy Director Christopher Barnhurst opened his keynote at AFCEA TechNet Cyber 2025 with this quote from Mike Tyson, “Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the face,” highlighting the need for readiness, agility and strong partnerships in an increasingly contested cyber domain.

-

-
April 2025

-
               [DISA enhances spectrum operations with new release](/NewsandEvents/2025/0428-EMBM-J-DS)

-
04/28/2025

-
               Announcing the launch of EMBM-J DS, a new software tool designed to improve electromagnetic spectrum management for enhanced warfighting communications and operational planning.

-

-
               [DISA director works with Army to strengthen joint cyber operations](/NewsandEvents/2025/0409-Army-G6-visit)

-
04/09/2025

-
               Lt. Gen. Paul T. Stanton and Lt. Gen. Jeth B. Rey met to discuss initiatives for strengthening joint cyber operations, focusing on integration, aligning priorities, and maximizing resources.

-

-
               [‘A warrior ethos, technical mastery — necessities for cyber workforce,' DISA director tells cyber community](/NewsandEvents/2025/0407-A-warrior-ethos)

-
04/07/2025

-
               Speaking at the first DOD Cyber Workforce Summit, Lt. Gen. Stanton declared cyberspace a battleground where American talent and free thought are crucial to fight and win.

-

-
February 2025

-
               [DISA cancels 2025 Hybrid Cloud Symposium](/NewsandEvents/2025/0228-DISA-Cancels-Hybrid-Cloud-Symposium)

-
02/28/2025

-
               In accordance with the Department of Government Efficiency and Cost Efficiency initiative, DISA announced Feb. 28 that the 2025 Hybrid Cloud Symposium will be canceled.

-

-
